context: A mom and son chat about outdoor play
purpose: Teach: うみ/はく/キモ/フッ/遊ば/握ら/イーグル/窯

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、絵本の主人公、うみのねこちゃんなんだよ。
lines.en: Mom, the picture book—the hero is a sea cat!
lines.style: Quick, bright opening. Eager to share. Small voice but insistent. The lift of a child who wants you to know something important. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。風船、息をはく練習、お口でしてみようね。
lines.en: Yes. And let's practice blowing—try inflating this balloon with your mouth, okay?
lines.style: Warm, gentle redirection. Not dismissing him. Patient rhythm, like she's done this before. The kind of quiet that makes a child feel held.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 魚屋さん、キモが、お皿に入ってたよ、ちょっと、怖い。
lines.en: The fishmonger had fish livers on the plate—that was kind of scary.
lines.style: Observant wonder mixed with real discomfort. Hesitant rhythm, touching the scary part lightly. Trusting her to understand without making it bigger than it is.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんは、フッ素のうがい薬、毎日、使ってるのよ。
lines.en: Your dad uses fluoride mouthwash every day, you know.
lines.style: Practical, connecting thread. Not quite answering the fear directly—offering context instead. Matter-of-fact but warm. The efficiency of a mother who knows what he needs to hear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園で、お友達と、たくさん遊ばせてもらったよ、楽しい。
lines.en: I got to play a lot with my friends at the park today—it was so fun!
lines.style: Genuine joy, sudden brightness. The words tumble out. Small laugh underneath. The energy of a child riding the memory of a good day.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 手、ぎゅっと握らないで、優しく、繋いでね、翔くん。
lines.en: Hold my hand gently, okay? Don't squeeze so tight—let's link hands softly, Sho.
lines.style: Tender correction. Not scolding. Setting the frame for intimacy. Low, warm tone. A mother teaching her son how to be gentle without making him feel wrong.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 動物園で、イーグル、すごく大きかったよ、ママ!
lines.en: The eagle at the zoo was SO big, Mom!
lines.style: Pure awe and urgency. The words burst out. Eyes wide in the voice. Needs her to witness it with him. Breathless at the memory.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おじいちゃんち、薪窯で、ピザ焼いてくれたわね、夏に。
lines.en: Grandpa made pizza in the wood-fired kiln for us that summer, didn't he?
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic reach. Letting the memory settle. A mother savoring something good. Small smile in the voice. Grounding the child in warmth and family.
